newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian January industrial output -6.4pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Italian January industrial output -6.4pct yr/yr.

text.p: National Statistics Institute ISTAT gave the following provisional figures for industrial production, year-on-year, in January.
Note: (The industrial production index was rebased in January 1994 on 1990 levels, replacing a 1985-based index.)
- Istat said average daily output, non-seasonally adjusted, but workday adjusted, fell 2.7 percent year-on-year in January after an 11.1 percent fall in December 1996.
- Production of consumer goods, on an unadjusted basis, fell 5.4 percent year-on-year in January. Investment goods dropped 10.6 percent and intermediate goods fell 5.6 percent.

- On an unadjusted basis, production of leather goods fell 10.8 percent year-on-year, textile and clothing fell 8.8 percent, non-metal minerals dropped 14.5 percent, metals were down 10.8 percent, machinery down 11.8 percent and transportation down 13.5 percent. Paper products rose 8.5 percent and refineries and carbon coke rose 1.7 percent. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
